text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I have identified our current issues. I 
will resolve them before the next race.
choice_data_list:
What do you want to do about the review 
meeting?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Be magnificent. Be supreme. Always 
shine the brightest."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
'It wasn't bad' is not enough. The only 
outcome befitting our family is victory.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"If it's about the 'race review,' I had 
planned to do that after this."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...If you wish to sit in, please proceed 
to the separate room with the monitor."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we watched today's race video 
and exchanged opinions for the next one.
